activity_summary: At the Theatre in the afternoon the yard smelled of size and new paint. James has had the posts done over like marble and the heavens blue. Behind the arras Garnish had every part of the king's in rolls, tied and named, and the plot ruled on its pasteboard. He put Gaunt's roll into your hand: six weeks to get a dying man's England by heart. The king's roll, he said, would reach from here to the Curtain, and Burbage had it on Monday.

entities.context: Took the roll, and did not know his own lines in another man's hand.
